comparison_intro: Three separate character rules remove literal spaces, remove digits, or keep ASCII letters. The translations preserve the original text and calculate each result.

language_notes.sas: COMPRESS ka keeps letters. Fixed-width character results retain storage padding; comparison omits trailing padding. SAS harness is unexecuted.
language_notes.python: pandas uses literal replacement for spaces and regex character classes for digits/letters. A copy preserves the input DataFrame.
language_notes.r: Base R gsub replaces every match. fixed=TRUE treats the space literally; the two character-class patterns use regular expressions.

semantic_notes.title: Keep and remove are different rules
semantic_notes.text: [^A-Za-z] removes every non-letter. Including 0-9 in the allowed class wrongly keeps digits; removing digits must retain punctuation and internal spaces.

semantic_notes.title: Compare the intended characters
semantic_notes.text: ASCII only. Quotes in the CSV preserve leading and internal blanks. SAS trailing storage padding is excluded; Python/R checks preserve literal strings.

tests.name: Original fixture: all nine strings
tests.input: Original three text values, including "ABC 123 XYZ" and "Phone: 555-1234".
tests.expected: All three CSV result columns match, including "ABC  XYZ" (two spaces), "Phone: -" and letters-only "Phone".
tests.catches: Keeping digits for ka, dropping punctuation, or collapsing required internal spaces.

tests.name: Added ASCII character boundaries
tests.input: Empty text; three spaces; "123"; "aB_9- !"; " A 1 B".
tests.expected: Empty/blank rules, digit removal, punctuation retention and letters-only filtering match every expected CSV string.
tests.catches: Alphanumeric filtering, only-first-match replacement, stripping leading blanks or conflating the three operations.

tests.name: Preserve text, types and order
tests.input: All CSV strings in reverse order with custom row identifiers.
tests.expected: Source text unchanged; result columns remain character data; row order and all expected strings retained.
tests.catches: Input mutation, sorting, missing-string coercion or hard-coded result placement.

scope: Original ASCII fixture plus added empty, blank-only, digit-only and punctuation/space probes. Compare content ignoring SAS trailing storage padding. Unicode classes and general SAS modifier behavior are excluded.
